profile.headline: Software Engineer III at TransCore
profile.summary:
My professional goal right now is to gain experience at CU Direct. I am working as a software developer and am on the AutoMedia team. My main objectives for this company is to develop  functional requirements into our website, Assist other developers and to resolve software bugs when they occur. My secondary objectives are to provide consultative recommendations and solutions for other teams and assist 3rd level support for any software issues that may arise in other environments.

Specialties: skilled in web development, database programming and am passionate about these two skills. I have also worked with services such as NServiceBus which are very interesting.   

Programming skills:
 C#, MVC, ASP.NET, HTML5, Razor, Javascript, AngularJS, JQuery, Kendo UI, CSS3, Bootstrap, SQL, NServiceBus, VB.net, Web Services.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Working as a software engineer III, I have contribute to the development of Transcore’s product software using AngularJS as the front end, and ASP.NET MVC Web API as the back end. Implement CRUD stored procedures to support various data access layers’ calls. Applied current technologies to develop and present self-built applications to the Director of Software Engineering. Leveraged APIs from Reporting Services to build dynamic and maintainable reporting pages.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Contract
positions.description: Working as a software consultant, I have contribute to the development of Transcore’s product software using AngularJS as the front end, and ASP.NET MVC Web API as the back end. Implement CRUD stored procedures to support various data access layers’ calls. Applied current technologies to develop and present self-built applications to the Director of Software Engineering. Leveraged APIs from Reporting Services to build dynamic and maintainable reporting pages.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description: Working as a software developer, my main objectives for this company is the development of web application solutions. My secondary objectives are to provide consultative recommendations and solutions for other teams, Investigate and resolve software issues that may arise as well as assist 3rd level support for production issues.

positions.title: Web Development Support
positions.description: I worked part-time with the web development team that develops both the internal/external web pages. The technology used on these sites includes a mix of classic ASP .Net web pages, .Net Web Services, and a SQLServer database backend. I will work on creating, enhancing, and optimizing existing web pages using Visual Studio 2008/2010 and SQLServer.

positions.title: Math Assistant/Substitute Teacher
positions.description:
Explained mathematical problems and procedures to a foreign class from China.
Worked with multiple groups and managed students as a team leader

positions.title: Computer Department/Human Resource
positions.description:
Installed Microsoft Windows Software on 20 computers on a weekly basis.
Studied and understood the different types of computers to best suit customer needs.
I won employee of the week twice for my perfect attendance and perseverant work attitude.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Business Administration with an emphasis in Computer Information System
